description: This Java source file defines an enumeration 'ProtocolMessageType' used to specify different WebSocket message types for controlling event and message emission, including methods for retrieving identifiers and streaming types.

classes.name: ProtocolMessageType
classes.description: Enumeration representing various WebSocket protocol message types for controlling event and message streaming, with associated identifiers and streaming types.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the string identifier associated with the protocol message type.

methods.name: isStartSending
methods.description: Indicates whether the message type signifies a start streaming command.

methods.name: getStreamingTypeOrThrow
methods.description: Returns the associated StreamingType or throws NoSuchElementException if not applicable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string identifier of the message type.
